data.text: Make a research how ddflow could manage and orchestrate swarm of agents, locally started by ddflow, or remote, various families, and distribute tasks between them, making the best of it. See what are the best practices, algorithms, distribution, data sharing, session info sharing, what others do, what kimi swarm agents are, etc, what we plan to do and what could we extend and reuse and make me a proposal
could hooks be installed if ddflow orchestrate them with Claude but runs for example opencode v2 or kilo or cursor, Gemini, grok, qwen, etc as coding agents for the execution?
